goal_summary: Miami Beach Halloween Half Marathon, Sat 2026-10-24 (12-wk block, wks 5-16). Goal: sub-2:05, stretch sub-2:00 (PR 1:52, not chasing this cycle). Weeks 5-6: rebuild consistency post-travel before loading anything. Speed days are optional (tempo/interval choice vs. an easy-run alternative) starting wk 7 — never mandatory. Target paces: easy/long ~10:00-10:30/mi, optional tempo ~9:05-9:20/mi, optional intervals ~8:30-8:50/mi, goal race pace 9:10-9:32/mi. Mild deficit continues for weight-loss secondary goal; never a deficit day-of/day-before the long run.

sketch: Weeks 8-9 (base, cont.): easy volume to ~17-18 mi/wk, long run to 6.5-7 mi, Thursday quality_optional continues weekly (tempo option grows to ~15-20 min). Weeks 10-13 (build): add optional race-pace intervals (Option A ~8:30-8:50/mi reps vs. Option B easy), long run grows to 8-9 mi, down week (-30% volume) around wk 12 or 13. Weeks 14-15 (peak): highest volume, peak long run 10-11 mi with race-pace segments, quality stays optional. Week 16 (taper/race wk, Oct 19-25): volume -40-60%, short shakeout runs only, freshness over fitness.
